-- Find active members by tier as of the end of FY2024/25 P08 (2024-12-22)
-- Active = had a transaction during the period
WITH period_members AS (
  -- Members with sales transactions
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND m.member_id IS NOT NULL
    
  UNION
  
  -- Members with returns
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM fact_return_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.return_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND m.member_id IS NOT NULL
    
  UNION
  
  -- Members with web orders
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM fact_web_order f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(f.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND m.member_id IS NOT NULL
    
  UNION
  
  -- Members with campaign exposure
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(f.contact_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
)
SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS active_members
FROM period_members
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, calendar_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date IN (CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE), CAST('2025-10-15' AS DATE))
ORDER BY calendar_date DESC

SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as min_date, MAX(calendar_date) as max_date
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) as min_date, MAX(calendar_date) as max_date
FROM dim_date
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
